original_test_intent: Read the selected Manager's HostInterfaces collection and inventory BMC-to-host interface resources without changing BMC or host connectivity.
original_method: Resolve the Manager's advertised HostInterfaces link, perform one trusted GET, validate collection identity/count/member links, redact host/topology/authentication-sensitive fields and confirm no state change.
manual_activity: Provide read-only BMC access, CA trust, firmware schema and the approved policy for host-interface topology/authentication evidence; no host or BMC network change is required.
required_inputs: Managers collection membership and advertised HostInterfaces link
safety_requirements: Never PATCH, POST or follow HostInterface actions
Validate Manager and canonical same-origin member links
Redact host addresses, VLANs, hostnames, credentials/tokens and authentication metadata
Do not infer reachability or trust from resource presence
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC, Manager and firmware identity
Capture HTTP metadata and restricted raw hash
Validate collection type, count and unique member links
Check every member remains under the selected Manager
Summarize safe status and function metadata
Confirm no BMC/host network or log state changed
engineer_actions: Provide any required HostInterface inventory and evidence policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The collection GET fits, but `-k`, embedded credentials, log clearing, unredacted full output and readability-only acceptance are unsafe and incomplete for host-facing resources.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the Manager's advertised HostInterfaces URI for one trusted GET, validate collection/member containment, redact host/auth topology and prohibit any action or write traversal.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager HostInterfaces GET and 15/10 timing remain; no ManagerId, member set, host role or authentication behavior is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Audit HostInterfaces as a parent collection with strict identity containment and privacy treatment for host-facing transport/authentication metadata.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes evidence clearing and insecure/raw capture and adds collection consistency, host/BMC scope separation, same-origin membership and redaction.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers HostInterface inventory only; it does not validate child HostEthernetInterfaces, credential negotiation, traffic flow or failover.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid collection does not show that host-side drivers or channels are operational, and a resource's presence must not be treated as authentication success.

project_override_considerations: Project expected resources should be matched by stable identity and firmware contract, not array position. Authentication-related properties may be reported only in approved redacted form.
expected_evidence: HTTP status/content type/timing and restricted raw hash
Collection identity/count and unique member containment
Proof no BMC/host network/configuration action or log clear occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, URI and GET consistently identify the HostInterfaces collection. Unsafe setup and insufficient acceptance criteria do not create a competing test identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Normal identity, access, schema and redaction inputs are sufficient for deterministic read-only automation.

review_improvement: Turns a raw HostInterfaces dump into a Manager-contained, privacy-safe parent-resource inventory distinct from both EthernetInterfaces and child host Ethernet resources.
independent_technical_reasoning: HostInterfaces describe the management bridge toward the host rather than the BMC's ordinary network ports. Their member links and properties may reveal host addresses, authentication mechanisms or topology. The test therefore needs collection-level containment, count and uniqueness checks plus stricter evidence redaction. It cannot claim traffic, host-driver or authentication coverage from resource presence. All required checks are bounded GET operations, supporting full automation while preserving the scope distinction.
